LALLA CARE : AN AGENTIC AI BABY MONITORING SYSTEM . 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Overview of the Lalla Care Website 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
Lalla Care is a baby monitoring website that helps parents track their baby in real time through a 
live video feed. It offers features such as sleep tracking, activity history, environmental 
monitoring, alerts, and a built-in assistant to answer questions.

, activity history, environmental 
monitoring, alerts, and a built-in assistant to answer questions. The website is designed for non-
technical users and provides a simple, organized layout with six main pages: Dashboard, Live 
Feed, Sleep Logs, Activity, Alerts, and Settings. A chatbot assistant is available on all pages to 
help answer user questions about either baby care or how to use the website.

help answer user questions about either baby care or how to use the website. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Main Navigation Bar Overview 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The main navigation bar appears at the very top of every page. It contains the Lalla Care logo on 
the left and five navigation tabs on the right. The tabs are Dashboard, Live Feed, Sleep Logs, 
Activity, and Settings. Clicking any tab switches to its corresponding page. The active page is 
marked with a highlighted underline.

marked with a highlighted underline. This navigation bar serves as the primary way to move 
between sections of the website.

CHUNK CONTENT: 
The navigation tabs appear horizontally across the top of all pages. The tabs are: 
Dashboard: Opens the home page with camera feed and daily summaries. 
Live Feed: Opens a dedicated view of the camera with enhanced controls.

CHUNK TITLE: Dashboard Page – General Overview 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The Dashboard is the main landing page and central hub of the website. It provides a real-time

view of the baby’s environment, daily summary cards, quick actions, audio monitoring, 
environmental conditions, and recent activity. The Dashboard automatically loads first when the 
user enters the site or when clicking the Dashboard tab at the top. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Dashboard – Last Update Indicator 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The Last Update Indicator is located in the top right of the Dashboard page. It displays the time 
of the most recent data update along with a small pulsing indicator.

of the most recent data update along with a small pulsing indicator. This helps users confirm 
that the monitoring system is actively refreshing and connected. No interaction is required; the 
indicator updates automatically. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Dashboard – Live Camera Feed Area 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The Live Camera Feed occupies a large area on the left side of the Dashboard. It includes a 
camera header showing the camera name and a label indicating the feed is live.

cannot be interacted with directly. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Dashboard – Daily Summary Cards 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The Daily Summary Cards are located below the camera feed on the left side.

CHUNK CONTENT: 
The Daily Summary Cards are located below the camera feed on the left side. They show key 
daily statistics including total sleep duration, number of feeding sessions, number of diaper 
changes, and total sleep change compared to previous days. Each card includes a value and a 
percentage increase or decrease, displayed using up or down arrows. The cards are 
informational and do not require user interaction.

CHUNK TITLE: Dashboard – Control Buttons Area 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
Just below the summary cards on the left side are three control buttons: Night Light, Lullaby, 
and Alerts. The Night Light button toggles the nursery night light. The Lullaby button plays

soothing music. The Alerts button navigates directly to the Alerts page. These buttons provide 
quick access to commonly used actions. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Dashboard – Audio Monitor Card 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The Audio Monitor Card is located on the right side of the Dashboard. It displays animated 
sound bars that represent the audio levels detected in the nursery. This visual representation 
helps users observe sound activity even when not listening directly.

and has no buttons. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Dashboard – Temperature and Humidity Card 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
This card appears on the right side below the Audio Monitor. It displays the current temperature 
in Fahrenheit and humidity percentage in the nursery. A circular "Listen In" button is present at 
the center, enabling the user to activate live audio listening.

The Recent Activity Feed is at the bottom right of the Dashboard.

CHUNK TITLE: Live Feed Page Overview 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The Live Feed page provides an expanded camera view with controls for zoom, brightness, night 
mode, and recording. It is accessed by clicking the Live Feed tab in the top navigation bar. This 
page is designed for users who want full control over viewing and adjusting the camera feed.

CHUNK TITLE: Live Feed – Page Header 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
At the top of the Live Feed page is the header section, displaying the title "Live Camera Feed," 
the camera name, and the last update indicator. This helps users confirm they are viewing the 
most recent feed. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Live Feed – Enhanced Video Feed Section 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The main video feed is displayed on the left side. It includes a larger view than the Dashboard 
and provides several user controls below it.

and provides several user controls below it. These include a zoom slider ranging from 1x to 3x, a 
brightness slider ranging from 0 to 100 percent, a night mode toggle, and a recording button 
that turns red when activated. This section is designed for viewing and adjusting the camera 
feed.

CHUNK CONTENT: 
Below the main video controls are additional action buttons.

Below the main video controls are additional action buttons. These include a snapshot button 
for taking a picture, a two-way audio button for speaking through the monitor, a night light 
toggle, and a lullaby playback button. These buttons allow users to interact with the baby’s 
environment without navigating back to the Dashboard.

CHUNK TITLE: Live Feed – Status Cards Sidebar 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
On the right side of the Live Feed page is a vertical sidebar containing status cards. These cards 
display the baby's state (such as sleeping or awake), whether an adult is present, whether crying 
is detected, and the connection status for camera, audio, and system updates.

CHUNK TITLE: Sleep Logs Page Overview 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The Sleep Logs page is accessed through the top navigation. It provides detailed information on

sleep patterns and statistics. This page helps parents understand how long the baby has slept, 
how often the baby wakes up, and the overall sleep quality. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Sleep Logs – Time Period Selector 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
At the top right of the Sleep Logs page is a time period selector. It allows users to view sleep 
data for Today, Week, or Month. Selecting a time period updates the statistics and charts shown 
on the page.

on the page. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Sleep Logs – Statistics Cards 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
Five statistics cards are displayed near the top of the Sleep Logs page. They show total sleep 
duration, average session length, number of wake-ups, longest session duration, and an overall 
sleep quality score. These cards provide a condensed summary of the baby’s sleep for the 
selected time period.

CHUNK TITLE: Sleep Logs – Sleep Pattern Chart 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
A large chart on the left side of the Sleep Logs page displays sleep patterns over time. Sleep 
periods are highlighted, while awake periods appear differently. Hour markers help users 
interpret when sleep occurred throughout the day.

CHUNK TITLE: Sleep Logs – Sleep Quality Score Gauge 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
On the right side of the Sleep Logs page is a circular gauge showing the baby’s overall sleep 
quality score. This visual meter provides an intuitive understanding of how restful the baby’s 
sleep has been.

CHUNK TITLE: Sleep Logs – Recent Sleep Sessions List 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
At the bottom of the Sleep Logs page is a scrollable list of recent sleep sessions. Each entry

includes start and end times, duration, date, and a quality label such as excellent, good, or poor. 
This gives users a detailed record of each sleep period. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Activity Page Overview 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The Activity page provides a complete list of all events recorded. It helps parents understand 
the baby's entire day, including sleep periods, wake events, crying, feeding sessions, and adult 
visits. The page also includes summaries and insights based on selected time periods.

CHUNK CONTENT: 
A time period selector in the top right allows the user to view activity for Today, Week, or 
Month. Selecting a time period updates the timeline and summaries on the page.

CHUNK TITLE: Activity Page – Activity Filter Buttons 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
Below the header are several filter buttons that allow users to narrow the view to specific 
activity types such as sleep, wake, crying, feeding, or adult visits. Clicking a filter highlights it and 
updates the list below to show only the chosen activity type.

CHUNK TITLE: Activity Page – Activity Timeline 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The main part of the Activity page is a vertical timeline in the center. A line runs down the left 
side, with circular icons marking each activity. To the right of each icon is a card with details 
such as description, timestamp, duration, and additional notes. Users can scroll to view older 
activities.

CHUNK TITLE: Activity Page – Activity Summary Cards 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
At the bottom of the Activity page are three summary cards. These show the most active hours

of the day, the distribution of different activity types, and quick insights about patterns such as 
sleep consistency or feeding routine. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Alerts Page Overview 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The Alerts page provides a full history of system alerts. These alerts notify parents of important 
events such as crying detection, unusual movement, adult presence, or environmental issues. 
This page helps users review what has happened and clear alerts when needed.

environmental issues.

CHUNK TITLE: Alerts Page – Page Header 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The top of the Alerts page contains the title "Alert History," a brief description, and a "Clear All" 
button positioned on the top right. This allows the user to remove all past alerts at once. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Alerts Page – Alert List 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The Alert List occupies the main portion of the page.

TLE: Alerts Page – Alert List 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The Alert List occupies the main portion of the page. Each alert is displayed as a card with a 
colored left border indicating severity: red for critical, orange for warnings, and blue for 
informational. Each alert includes a message, timestamp, and a severity label. Users can scroll to 
browse all alerts. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Alerts Page – Empty State Display 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
When no alerts exist, an empty state appears at the center of the page.

ate Display 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
When no alerts exist, an empty state appears at the center of the page. It shows a large 
clipboard icon, a message stating that no alerts are found, and a note explaining that the alert 
history is currently empty. This helps the user understand that no issues are present. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Settings Page Overview 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The Settings page is accessed via the top navigation bar and allows users to configure the

monitoring system. Users can enter their camera URL, adjust alert frequency, enable or disable 
various detection options, and start or stop monitoring. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Settings Page – Camera Configuration Card 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
This card appears on the left side of the Settings page. It contains a field where users can enter 
their camera's URL and a field to adjust the alert cooldown time. Alert cooldown determines 
how many seconds must pass between repeated alerts.

alert cooldown time. Alert cooldown determines 
how many seconds must pass between repeated alerts. This card is essential for connecting the 
camera feed and controlling alert frequency. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Settings Page – Detection Settings Card 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
Located on the right side of the Settings page, this card includes checkboxes for enabling or 
disabling Baby Detection, Adult Detection, and Crying Detection. Users can customize the types 
of monitoring they want active.

CHUNK TITLE: Settings Page – Monitoring Control Card 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
At the bottom of the Settings page is a wide card with three main buttons: Start Monitoring, 
Stop Monitoring, and Save Settings. Save Settings applies changes. Start Monitoring activates 
the monitoring system using the saved preferences. Stop Monitoring halts all monitoring 
processes.

the monitoring system using the saved preferences. Stop Monitoring halts all monitoring 
processes. When active, the Start button changes to show that monitoring is running. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Chatbot Assistant Overview 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The chatbot assistant appears on every page as a floating circular button located at the bottom-
right corner. Clicking the button opens a chat window. The assistant provides guidance on using 
the website and answers general baby care questions.

ndow. The assistant provides guidance on using 
the website and answers general baby care questions. The chatbot is always accessible. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Chatbot – Floating Button Details

CHUNK CONTENT: 
The floating button stays anchored to the bottom-right corner. When closed, it displays a 
circular icon. A notification indicator may appear when new information is available. Users click 
this button to open or close the chatbot window. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Chatbot – Chat Window Header 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
When opened, the chat window appears with a header at the top.

– Chat Window Header

When opened, the chat window appears with a header at the top. The header contains an icon, 
the title "BabyBot Assistant," a subheading stating the bot is ready to help, and a close button 
on the right side. Clicking the close button hides the chat window.

The central portion of the chatbot window displays the message history.

CHUNK TITLE: Chatbot – Quick Questions Buttons 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
At the beginning of a conversation, four quick question buttons appear at the bottom of the 
messages area. These buttons allow users to ask common questions, such as inquiries about 
sleep, crying, feeding, or temperature.

CHUNK TITLE: Chatbot – Input Area 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The bottom section of the chatbot contains a text input box with a placeholder that prompts 
users to type their question. A send button positioned to the right transmits the message. Users 
can also press the Enter key to send questions. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions – Camera Setup

CHUNK CONTENT: 
Users often ask how to connect their camera. The answer is: open the Settings page, find the 
Camera Configuration card, enter the camera URL into the designated field, and click Save 
Settings. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions – Start Monitoring 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
To begin monitoring, users must go to the Settings page, ensure that the correct camera URL 
and detection options are configured, click Save Settings, and then press the Start Monitoring 
button.

button. The button changes appearance when monitoring is active. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions – Alert Levels 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
Alerts have three levels. Informational alerts indicate general updates. Warning alerts indicate 
something that needs attention. Critical alerts indicate urgent situations that require immediate 
action. These can be reviewed on the Alerts page.

indicate urgent situations that require immediate 
action. These can be reviewed on the Alerts page. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions – Viewing Sleep Patterns 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
Sleep patterns can be viewed on the Sleep Logs page. Users can choose Today, Week, or Month 
using the time selector. Statistics cards and charts show patterns, quality, and session history.

CHUNK TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions – Controlling Nursery Features 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
Users can toggle the night light or play a lullaby from the Dashboard using the control buttons 
or from the Live Feed page under Quick Actions. These features help users soothe or check on 
the baby remotely. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions – Daily Summary Meaning

CHUNK CONTENT: 
The Daily Summary shows today’s totals for sleep duration, feeding frequency, diaper changes, 
and overall sleep time. Percentage changes compare today’s values to previous days. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions – Viewing All Activities 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
To view the baby’s full activity timeline, users should go to the Activity page. They can filter by 
activity type and select a time period such as Today, Week, or Month.

CHUNK TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions – Alert Cooldown Explanation 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
Alert cooldown is the number of seconds between repeated alerts of the same type. This 
prevents receiving repeated notifications too frequently. The cooldown setting is located in the 
Camera Configuration card under Settings.

ns too frequently. The cooldown setting is located in the 
Camera Configuration card under Settings. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions – Disabling Detection Types 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
Users can disable Baby Detection, Adult Detection, or Crying Detection through the Detection 
Settings card on the Settings page by unchecking the corresponding boxes.

Settings card on the Settings page by unchecking the corresponding boxes. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions – Clearing All Alerts 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
Users can remove all alerts at once by opening the Alerts page and selecting the Clear All button 
at the top right. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions – Audio Monitor Function 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The Audio Monitor on the Dashboard displays moving sound bars that reflect live audio levels 
from the nursery.

CHUNK TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions – Using Listen In Feature 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The Listen In feature is located inside the Temperature and Humidity card on the Dashboard. 
Pressing the circular Listen In button activates live audio streaming from the nursery. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions – Capturing a Snapshot 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
On the Live Feed page, the Capture Snapshot button below the video feed allows users to take a 
still picture from the camera.

Capture Snapshot button below the video feed allows users to take a 
still picture from the camera. The snapshot is captured instantly. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Frequently Asked Questions – Status Indicators Meaning 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
Color-coded dots and borders are used throughout the website. A green dot indicates 
something is active or connected. A red dot indicates a critical alert. A pulsing dot means the 
system is receiving live updates.

CHUNK TITLE: Color and Visual Indicator Guide 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
Green and teal tones indicate normal operation and good conditions. Blue is used for 
informational updates. Orange indicates warnings that may require attention soon. Red 
indicates critical alerts. Alert cards display a colored border to match the alert severity.

indicates critical alerts. Alert cards display a colored border to match the alert severity. Icons for 
activities and states appear on Timeline cards and status cards to help differentiate events. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Quick Navigation Instructions 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
To view the baby: open Dashboard or Live Feed. 
To check sleep patterns: open Sleep Logs. 
To review today’s events: open Activity. 
To view alerts: open Alerts. 
To change settings or connect a camera: open Settings.

CHUNK TITLE: Real-Time Update Behavior 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
The website updates data automatically. The camera feed refreshes continuously. Status cards 
show live information. Alerts appear in real time as events occur. Activity logs also update 
automatically. The Last Update indicator confirms that fresh data is being received.

CHUNK TITLE: Getting Started Steps for New Users 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
New users should begin by opening the Settings page, entering their camera URL, setting an 
alert cooldown value, selecting which detections to enable, clicking Save Settings, and then 
clicking Start Monitoring. After monitoring begins, the Dashboard shows live data.

clicking Start Monitoring. After monitoring begins, the Dashboard shows live data. 
 
CHUNK TITLE: Recommended Tips for Best Use 
CHUNK CONTENT: 
For the best experience, users should check the Dashboard frequently for quick updates, use 
Sleep Logs to track long-term patterns, check Activity for daily details, enable only needed 
detections to avoid unnecessary alerts, set an appropriate cooldown to prevent alert spam, and 
rely on the chatbot for assistance.
